items.stem: State any three services of retailers to manufacturers and wholesalers.

items.stem: A wholesaler pays Das Retail in cash at once and sometimes gives it advances. Which service of a wholesaler or retailer is illustrated? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Financial assistance. Wholesalers finance manufacturers.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for identifying Financial assistance; 2 marks for the justification: Wholesalers finance manufacturers.

items.stem: Which of the following is one of the features of departmental stores?
items.answer: Combine retailing with warehousing
items.markingKey: (a) "Combine retailing with warehousing" is one of the features of departmental stores; the others are features of chain stores.
options: Each shop under a branch manager
